meta.title: Athar
meta.description: Local donation campaigns with an open ledger: orphan sponsorship, home renovation, medical aid — Local Council, Salamiyah

home.empty: There are no published campaigns in this category right now.
home.heroTitle: Salamiyah’s donations, with an account anyone can read
home.heroBody: The council runs campaigns for orphan sponsorship, home renovation and medical aid. Every lira is recorded: what was collected, what was spent and for whom — without revealing anyone’s identity.

steps.title: Pick a campaign
steps.body: Sponsorship, renovation or medical aid: each has its own target and account.

steps.title: Pay
steps.body: A transfer or local e-wallet with the receipt uploaded, or cash at a nearby collection point.

steps.title: We verify
steps.body: The finance verifier matches the amount, issues an official receipt and you are notified at once.

steps.title: We spend with proof
steps.body: Every payment out is recorded with an invoice or photo and shown on the campaign.

adminCategories.title: Campaign categories

adminCategories.flagHospital: Paid only to the approved hospital

adminCampaigns.title: Campaigns
adminCampaigns.intro: Every council campaign and its status. Medical campaigns are published from case review.

manage.publishHint: It goes public now and alerts opted-in donors if it is urgent.
manage.pauseHint: The campaign stays visible; new donations are refused on the web and in the app. Earlier donations still go on to verification.
manage.resumeHint: The Donate button returns to the campaign page and the app.
manage.completeHint: Donations stop for good; the campaign and its accounts stay public.
manage.closeHint: Closing hides the campaign from every public page and total, so it is only allowed for a campaign with no verified money and no donations awaiting verification.
manage.closeConfirm: Yes, close the campaign for good
manage.closeBlocked: This campaign cannot be closed: it holds verified money or donations awaiting verification. Mark it completed when it ends.
manage.reviewPending: The medical case went back to review, so donations stay paused until the case officer publishes it again.
manage.finalNote: No further actions: this stage is final.
manage.openPledges: {count, plural, =0 {No donations awaiting verification} one {1 donation awaiting verification} other {# donations awaiting verification}}
manage.editHint: Title, summary and cover as donors see them. No names, no photos of people.
manage.updatesHint: Shown on the public campaign page, newest first.
manage.updatePosted: Update posted on the campaign page.
manage.noUpdates: No updates yet. Tell donors what has been achieved.

collector.title: Collection points
collector.clearanceBody: Every amount you receive is recorded in your name and handed to the council. Once the finance verifier matches it, you are cleared of it.
collector.searchHint: The donor shows a reference starting with P-. Search it, then confirm receipt.
collector.referenceInvalid: Type the reference as the donor shows it, e.g. P-8T6NZ7.
collector.referenceNotFound: No cash donation with this reference at your points.
collector.pendingEmpty: No cash donations are waiting for you right now.

collector.confirmed: Receipt of {reference} confirmed and handed to the finance verifier.

state.COLLECTED: Handed to the council, awaiting matching
state.REJECTED: Needs a review with the council

collector.recordTitle: Record an amount from the point's box
collector.recordIntro: For a box total or a cash gift without a reference. It is recorded in your name and handed over for matching.
collector.recorded: Amount recorded and handed over for matching.
collector.amountInvalid: Enter a valid amount in digits.
collector.historyIntro: Everything you confirmed or recorded, and its matching status.
collector.historyEmpty: You have not handed over any amount yet.

spending.title: Campaign spending
spending.intro: Each campaign's balance: collected and verified, spent, and left to spend. Pick a campaign to record spending with its proof.
spending.pageIntro: Every payment is recorded with an invoice or photo and never exceeds the remaining balance (verified − spent).
spending.formIntro: The payment appears on the campaign's public record. The proof is published only if you choose so.
spending.payeeLabel: Payee name as the public sees it
spending.payeeLabelHint: A company, shop or general description. Never a beneficiary's name.
spending.lockedTitle: This campaign pays the approved hospital only
spending.lockedHint: No other payee is possible. Changing the hospital sends the case back to review and pauses donations.
spending.overBalance: The amount is above the remaining balance ({remaining}).
spending.proofHint: JPG, PNG or PDF up to 5 MB. Location data is removed from photos automatically.
spending.publishProof: Publish the proof on the campaign's public record
spending.publishProofHint: Only if you checked that no beneficiary name, face or number shows. Unpublished proofs stay staff-only.
spending.recorded: Payment recorded and shown on the campaign record.
spending.recordedCompleted: Payment recorded. Spending reached the campaign target: completed.
spending.amountInvalid: Enter a valid amount above zero.
spending.proofRequired: Attach the invoice or a photo as proof.
spending.monthlyIntro: One payment per sponsored orphan at their monthly amount, recorded by code only. A month cannot be paid twice.
spending.markIntro: Ongoing programmes do not complete by themselves. When the programme ends, mark it completed: donations stop and the file is closed.
spending.viewOnly: View only: the finance verifier records spending.
spending.completedNote: The target amount was spent on the beneficiaries.

transparency.metaDescription: Total donations verified by the Local Council in Salamiyah, what was spent, and how many beneficiaries were helped, without revealing anyone’s identity.

transparency.lead: Live figures from the published campaign accounts. No donation counts until a finance verifier has matched it, and no spending is recorded without an invoice or photo.
transparency.collected: Collected and verified by the council

transparency.otherCurrency: Campaigns in {currency}: {verified} collected, {spent} spent. Never converted or added to the pound totals.
transparency.categoriesIntro: Each bar is what was collected in that category; the green part has been spent, the orange part is still in the account.
transparency.campaignsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No campaigns yet} one {# campaign} other {# campaigns}}
transparency.beneficiariesCount: {count, plural, =0 {No beneficiaries yet} one {# beneficiary} other {# beneficiaries}}
transparency.monthlyTitle: Collected and spent over twelve months

transparency.channelsIntro: Donations verified by the council, by how they came in.

transparency.kindsIntro: Beneficiaries linked to published campaigns, by kind. Each one is shown by a code only.

transparency.recentDonationsTitle: Latest donations verified by the council

how.title: Every donation matched
how.body: A finance verifier matches the receipt or the cash received before any amount joins the total, and nobody verifies a donation they recorded themselves.

how.title: Official receipt with a QR code
how.body: Every verified donation gets an official receipt number; anyone can scan its code to confirm it on this site.

how.title: Spending with public proof
how.body: No spending is recorded without an invoice or photo, and never beyond the campaign balance. Proofs that are safe to publish appear in each campaign’s record.

how.title: Never an identity
how.body: We show a beneficiary’s code and kind only. Names, phone numbers and documents stay with the council and never appear on a public page.

transparency.demoNote: Simulated (Demo) payments used to show the electronic payment methods are not included in any figure on this page.
transparency.demoAmount: They currently total {amount}, shown here only.

users.title: Users

users.pointsHint: Mukhi accounts only: they see the donations at these points and no others.
